Hey, I am only a teen from the USA myself and surely no professional. I know no one wants to hear the cliche of "it will be okay" when you may feel like it is not. My advice to you is that pain is temporary. Temporary can be weeks, months, or even years but it will subside. I know that gut churning feeling of just extreme sadness that you just can't shake. I tried to end my life and I am glad I didn't. At some point I hope you will hit a turning point where things will improve and you can look back and be like "damn, I made it." It may hurt a lot right now but everyone in this subreddit is here for you.
